corrections.reason: The printed glyph is ፅ (6th order ፀ with the central crossbar), matching the Ge'ez root ኅሩይ/ምርፅ.
The word is የታመመ ('who was sick', contrasting with የዳነበትን 'when he was healed' on the next line); ink bleed on the second መ made it look like ቸ.
Both legs of 1st-order ነ are clearly visible in የዳነበትን ('the time in which he was healed').
The word is የታመመ ('that he was sick for eight years'), matching the parallel phrase in Column 1 Line 33.
Visual inspection and Amharic grammar confirm 6th-order እ in እያመኑ ('believing in our Lord, they turned...'), not negative አያመኑ.
Both legs of 1st-order ዘ are equal in length in the Ge'ez variant reading ዘዐራዘቶን.
The 4th-order feminine object suffix ኣ in ወአንሥኣ ('and he raised her up') is visible with the shortened left leg.
The 2nd-order plural verb ending ዑ in ወሰምዑ is visible on the right side of the character, matching plural ወአምኑ.
